facts: Completed 1991; stated height 235 m

facts: PDF page 18: level 35 internal floor outline dimensioned 56.9 m in both directions

visualReview: PDF pages 7, 18 and 25 rendered and inspected
Lower plan has two equal orthogonal steps at every corner

references.limits: Marketing plan dimensions are internal rentable extents, not surveyed outer cladding dimensions. Diagram levels and proportions are reference, not as-built elevations.

facts: Perimeter steel tube above second floor; braced core below
Composite steel deck floors
Perimeter columns at 3 m centres
50 storeys

references.role: Council on Vertical Urbanism building database
facts: Architectural and tip height 236 m from lowest significant open-air pedestrian entrance
50 above-ground floors; 3 below-ground floors

references.limits: Conflicts by 1 m with architect's 235 m. Resolve ground datum explicitly. Do not treat 244/245 m above datum claims as building height.

facts: Supplied and installed stainless steel louvred pyramid in 1991
references.limits: No pyramid dimensions provided. Modern product blade pitches are not evidence of this installation.

facts: Nine original revolving doors retrofitted
Seven have bullnose glazing
Drive systems moved to new canopy extensions above doors; larger new profiles matched original stainless finish
visualReview: Separate curved outer glass, four-wing revolving leaves, polished circular canopies, floor rings, tall adjacent sidelight doors and transom signs
references.limits: No exact door dimensions or plan coordinates supplied.

references.role: Earlier Canary Wharf owner brochure, hosted by commercial listing service
facts: Specification: punched windows 1.8 m wide and 2.75 m high; low-E double glazing.

Four ground-floor entrances.
references.limits: Text inspected through indexed PDF. Direct PDF download returned access denied; ground-floor drawing could not be visually inspected. Door distribution remains reconstructed. Its 244 m height claim has an unspecified datum and is not used.
